changelog: New spoken-punctuation arrows: with Spoken Punctuation on, say 'left arrow sign' (or 'বাম তীর চিহ্ন') while dictating and ← appears ('Dhaka left arrow sign Narayanganj' → 'Dhaka ← Narayanganj'), and likewise 'up arrow sign' → ↑, 'down arrow sign' → ↓, 'left right arrow sign' → ↔, 'up down arrow sign' → ↕ — completing the arrow set started with →, for dictating directions and price moves instead of typing ← ↑ ↓ ↔ ↕ by hand. A bare 'left', 'up' or 'down' still types as a word. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
